raw_response: DESCRIPTION: This figure presents three pie charts side by side, each representing a different category of linguistic or logical classification. The first chart, titled "Categorical," contains four slices: Universal Quantifiers at 29.07% shown in light blue, Negation at 27.91% in orange, Limiter at 27.91% in pink, and Existential Quantifiers at 15.12% in light green, with the three largest slices being nearly equal in size and the Existential Quantifiers slice being notably smaller. The second chart, titled "Approximate Number Generation," displays three slices: Approximate Quantities at 45.03% in pale yellow, Comparative Relationships at 36.26% in light blue, and Absolute Absence at 18.71% in light purple/lavender, arranged in descending order of size. The third chart, titled "Disjunctive & Conjunctive," is divided into two nearly equal slices: Conjunctive at 50.49% in light pink/mauve and Disjunctive at 49.51% in light purple/lavender. All three charts include percentage labels displayed directly inside their respective slices along with category names, and none of the charts include a separate legend. No slices appear to be visually exploded or offset from the main body of any chart.
